workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free next week:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30
Let me know which of these works for Elena and David.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you provided work for them. Here is a full list of 30-minute slots when they are both free next week. Can you please check which of these work for Priya and Marcus?
Mon: 10:00, 11:00, 11:30, 14:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 09:30, 13:00, 13:30, 16:00
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I've cross-referenced our lists and it looks like we have no common availability. I've double-checked the calendars for Priya and Marcus and there are no other times they can do. Would you be able to check with Elena or David to see if they have any flexibility in their schedules? It would be great if they could free up one of the slots I originally sent over. Let me know.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, thanks for checking. I've looked at the calendars again. I can see that David has a 'Partner lunch' scheduled for Wednesday at 15:00. This seems like an internal and potentially flexible meeting. All other partners are free at this time.
Perhaps we can propose this slot and ask if David would be able to reschedule his lunch? Let me know what you think. If you'd like me to propose another option, I can do that too.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks Brad, that's a great find. Priya and Marcus are both free on Wednesday at 15:00. I think it's a good idea to ask David to reschedule his lunch. Please go ahead and I'll wait for your confirmation. Once you give me the green light, I will book the meeting.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've sent the confirmation email to all partners for Wednesday at 15:00. I've asked David to confirm that he can move his lunch. Please go ahead and create the booking.

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

This email is to confirm a 30-minute meeting for next week, on Wednesday, November 18 at 15:00 Eastern.

David, we notice this conflicts with a 'Partner lunch' in your calendar. Would you be able to reschedule your lunch to accommodate this meeting?

If this time does not work, please let us know.

Best regards,
Brad
Scheduling Assistant
